clue.text: Another player, a robotic sort, not extremely cheery

clue.text: Swore a lawman will hold steady

clue.text: Summertime activity which requires seeding?

clue.text: States herb covers minced meat item

indicators.note: covers means wraps round, so the herb goes round the States letters

explanation.definitionFit: A sausage is a casing filled with minced meat.

clue.text: Point won, having received ball supply

clue.text: What's between the players overall

explanation.definitionFit: A tennis net stands between the opponents, and a net figure is the bottom-line total.

indicators.note: on means placed after the work word

clue.text: Refreshment that is ace, including bananas etc

clue.text: Trenches so safe when there's been an upheaval

clue.text: Servants keeping cold eggs for one player here

roe is the mass of eggs of a fish

clue.text: Data about men serving in shade of 14 12

parts.note: gen is slang for information or data
